page: Microsoft Azure E64ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 32 physical cores, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Additionally, the instance includes 3780 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong computational and memory performance. The server achieves top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core testing with a score of 22274.0 and small-model LLM prompt processing at 4658.62 tokens per second. It demonstrates strong performance in multi-core stress-ng tests, Passmark CPU evaluations, and database operations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for small cached blocks, reaching 4863.62 GB/sec, though large-block uncached read bandwidth drops to an average tier of 154.13 GB/sec. Single-threaded operations, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, perform at average levels.

Given its high memory density and substantial local NVMe storage, the E64ads_v6 provides a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the added cost of dedicated GPU hardware. The combination of 512 GB of RAM and 3780 GB of local disk capacity makes it highly efficient for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and memory-heavy enterprise applications. It is also well-suited for multi-threaded software compilation and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
